amunra.name: Amunra
amunra.description: Amun-Ra is mostly situational. He performs well in Delusions Den and PVP, as well as in Odysseus, but his performance in other areas is average.

skills.name: Aten's Radiance
skills.description: Amun-Ra releases solar energy and rises into air, gaining Super Armor. He fires a solar blade to strike the nearest enemy and nearby targets, dealing DMG equal to 100% of ATK. When cast, it does not drain Energy but consumes 200 Energy per sec.

upgrades.level2: Solar blades heal Amun-Ra for 100% of the DMG dealt.
upgrades.level3: Increases the DMG of solar blades to 140% ATK.
upgrades.level4: Reduces the attack interval of solar blades to 0.7s.

skills.name: Blinding Sun-Disk
skills.description: Amun-Ra creates a Solar Aura near himself for 6s, dealing DMG equal to 100% of ATK per sec to enemies inside and reducing their ATK by 20%.

upgrades.level2: Enemies inside Solar Aura have their ATK reduced by 30%.
upgrades.level3: Increases DMG per instance to 125% ATK.
upgrades.level4: Extends the duration of Solar Aura to 8s.

skills.name: Glare of Ra
skills.description: Amun-Ra gains 100% Dodge Rate for 8s at combat start.

upgrades.level2: Re-enters this state each time he casts the Ultimate.
upgrades.level3: Dodging an attack restores 50 Energy to Amun-Ra for the duration. This can only trigger once per sec.
upgrades.level4: Additionally gains 50% Effect RES for the duration. (Unlocks at Lv.261)

skills.name: The Dawn on Benben
skills.description: Increases all allies' M-RES and Armor by 50% for 15s at combat start. Amun-Ra gains Energy Regen boost, increasing his Energy Regen by 50%, until any ally falls.

upgrades.level2: When the Energy Regen boost expires, all allies instantly restore 200 Energy.
upgrades.level3: Increases his M-RES & Armor to 75%.
upgrades.level4: Increases his Energy Regen to 80%. (Unlocks at Lv.281)

relic.name: Sun-Blinded
relic.description: Blinding Sun-Disk remains permanently when cast, and its range moderately expands during Aten's Radiance. Enemies within range of Blinding Sun-Disk for 4s are stunned for 1s.

upgrades.level2: Enemies within range of Blinding Sun-Disk for 4s are stunned for 1.5s. (Unlock at Relic Lv.10)
upgrades.level3: Enemies within range of Blinding Sun-Disk for 4s are stunned for 2s. (Unlock at Relic Lv.20)
upgrades.level4: The enhanced Blinding Sun-Disk creates a black hole during Aten's Radiance, slowly pulling all enemies on the battlefield toward Amun-Ra. (Unlock at Relic Lv.30)

coreMechanic.summary: Deluxe edition Poseidon for PvE -- better grouping at higher investment cost. Dodge-stacking mechanic requires high investment to shine. Second-worst Celestial to invest in.

anubis.name: Anubis
anubis.description: Anubis is average, and he performs well almost everywhere, but he is best in PVP and in the tower, and worst in Grim Surge.

skills.name: Featherfall Judgment
skills.description: Anubis drains the soul of the weakest enemy, stunning them for 2s and dealing DMG equal to 450% of ATK. If the target is defeated when the skill ends, Anubis restores 600 Energy.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG dealt to 500% ATK.
upgrades.level3: Increases Anubis's ATK by 20% upon defeating a target. This boost lasts until the battle ends.
upgrades.level4: After defeating a target, Anubis restores 25% of his max HP.

skills.name: Underworld Soulfarer
skills.description: The first time an enemy's HP drops below 80% in a battle, Anubis fades into the void. He then appears behind that enemy, deals DMG equal to 240% of ATK, and stuns the target for 2s.

upgrades.level2: When dealing DMG, steals 150 Energy from the target.
upgrades.level3: Stun now lasts for 3s.
upgrades.level4: Increases DMG dealt to 300% ATK.

skills.name: Mythic Embalmer
skills.description: Each time Anubis loses a total of 50% of his max HP, he becomes immune to DMG and untargetable for 3s. This effect can only trigger once every 10s.

upgrades.level2: Increases Anubis's ATK by 20% until the battle ends when triggered.
upgrades.level3: Increases Lifesteal by 20% until the battle ends when triggered.
upgrades.level4: Increases ATK by 30% and grants 30% Lifesteal when triggered. (Unlocks at Lv.261)

skills.name: Shadowy Was-Scepter
skills.description: Spins his scepter to attack nearby enemies, dealing DMG equal to 210% of ATK and reducing their healing effects by 50% for 5s.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG dealt to 235% ATK.
upgrades.level3: Increases healing reduction to 80%.
upgrades.level4: DMG dealt increases to 260% ATK. (Unlocks at Lv.281)

relic.name: Tomb Protector
relic.description: Increases DMG dealt by Featherfall Judgment by 30% to enemies with less than 50% HP.

upgrades.level2: Enemies cannot receive healing during Featherfall Judgment. (Unlock at Relic Lv.10)
upgrades.level3: If an enemy drops below 5% HP after taking DMG from Featherfall Judgment, it executes that enemy. (Unlock at Relic Lv.20)
upgrades.level4: Increases DMG dealt by Featherfall Judgment by 50% to enemies with less than 50% HP. (Unlock at Relic Lv.30)

coreMechanic.summary: Vampiric healing, untargetable window after losing 40% cumulative HP, and execute (r20: kills enemies below 5% HP through invincible skills). Kill one by one in sequence.

aquarius.name: Aquarius
aquarius.description: Doxia, known as Aquarius is the goddess of wisdom, truth and knowledge. Her nearly human-sized vessel is both a source of insight and a wellspring of understanding.

skills.name: Stream's Wisdom
skills.description: Aquarius grants all allies a shield that absorbs DMG equal to 240% of ATK for 6s.

upgrades.level2: Shield Strength increases to 270% ATK.
upgrades.level3: Shield Strength increases to 300% ATK.

skills.name: Surge
skills.description: Aquarius locks onto the nearest enemy and then unleashes a torrent below the target, dealing 270% ATK as DMG and knocking them down.

upgrades.level2: DMG increases to 290% ATK.
upgrades.level3: Increases Aquarius's M-RES by 100% for 10s after casting the skill.
upgrades.level4: DMG increases to 320% ATK.

skills.name: Wavelet
skills.description: Aquarius applies a 6s shield to the weakest ally, absorbing DMG equal to 200% of ATK.

upgrades.level2: Shield Strength increases to 220% ATK.
upgrades.level3: The shielded unit takes 20% less DMG for the next 5s.

ares.name: Ares
ares.description: Ares, god of war, mutiny, slaughter and riot, is fierce beyond measure. Clad in feathered armor and leather bracers, he wields a terrifying circular saw, embodying unstoppable might.

skills.name: Battlefield Storm
skills.description: Ares swings his weapon, dealing DMG equal to 100% of ATK per sec to surrounding enemies for 6s. He is immune to Crowd Control for the duration.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG per sec to 110% ATK.
upgrades.level3: Gains a shield equal to 200% of ATK when the Ultimate ends.
upgrades.level4: Increases DMG per sec to 120%.

skills.name: Flesh Grinder
skills.description: Ares deals DMG equal to 200% of ATK to nearby enemies and reduces their Armor by 15% for 6s.

upgrades.level2: Reduces Armor by 20%.
upgrades.level3: Reduces Armor for 8s.
upgrades.level4: Reduces Armor by 25%.

skills.name: Unyielding Will
skills.description: The first time Ares takes lethal DMG, he becomes immune to the lethal DMG and gains immunity to all DMG & Crowd Control for the next 5s (it can only trigger once per battle).

upgrades.level2: Permanently increases Lifesteal by 20% upon triggering.
upgrades.level3: Increases the duration to 7s.
upgrades.level4: Permanently increases Lifesteal by 30% upon triggering.

skills.name: War God Spirit
skills.description: Ares's ATK increases as his HP drops, with a maximum boost of 90% ATK.

upgrades.level2: Increases ATK by up to 105%.
upgrades.level3: Also gains up to 30% CRIT Rate.
upgrades.level4: Increases ATK by up to 120%.

relic.name: Celestial Dusk
relic.description: During Battlefield Storm, Ares takes 80% reduced DMG.

upgrades.level2: While Battlefield Storm is active, Ares gains a shield equal to 200% ATK upon defeating an enemy. (Unlock at Relic Lv.10)
upgrades.level3: During Battlefield Storm, Ares is immune to all DMG, and this does not affect the duration of other immunity skills. (Unlock at Relic Lv.20)
upgrades.level4: While Battlefield Storm is active, Ares gains a shield equal to 240% ATK upon defeating an enemy. (Unlock at Relic Lv.30)

coreMechanic.summary: 5-second invincibility window is his only value. Easily countered. CN: 5-second lifespan. Do not invest.

aries.name: Aries
aries.description: Irena, known as Aries, rules over war and courage, granting mortals the will to fight and the spirit to press forward.

skills.name: Tenacious Bloodline
skills.description: Permanently gains 20% Lifesteal in battle.

upgrades.level2: Increases ATK by 10%. (Unlocks at Lv.81)
upgrades.level3: Increases Lifesteal gained to 25%. (Unlocks at Lv.141)

skills.name: Swipe 'Em
skills.description: Deals 270% ATK as DMG to the nearest target and knocks them down.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG dealt to 300% ATK. (Unlocks at Lv.21)
upgrades.level3: Reduces the Move SPD & ATK SPD of hit enemies by 50% for 5s. (Unlocks at Lv.121)
upgrades.level4: Increases DMG dealt to 330% ATK. (Unlocks at Lv.161)

skills.name: Aries Pounce
skills.description: Aries leaps up and slams down, dealing 360% ATK as DMG to enemies in a cone and knocking them back.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG dealt to 400% ATK. (Unlocks at Lv.41)
upgrades.level3: Ignores 20% of the targets' Armor. (Unlocks at Lv.101)

artemis.name: Artemis
artemis.description: Artemis, mistress of beasts and sovereign of the wild, rules hunting, wildlife, the moon and the protection of maidens.

skills.name: Gale-Force Shot
skills.description: Artemis leaps to the very back of the battlefield and moves along the edge while firing 1 shot every 0.7s, dealing PEN DMG equal to 180% of ATK. The skill lasts 8s, and Artemis gains Super Armor for the duration.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG per shot to 200% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: Extends the duration to 10s.
upgrades.level4: Increases DMG per shot to 220% of ATK.

skills.name: Steadied Shot
skills.description: Fires a net at the nearest enemy, ensnaring them in place for 2s and dealing DMG equal to 270% of ATK.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG dealt to 300% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: Ensnared enemies have their Dodge Rate reduced by 50% for 8s.
upgrades.level4: Increases DMG dealt to 330% of ATK.

skills.name: Hunter’s Snare
skills.description: When a nearby target attacks Artemis, she gains an additional 50% Dodge Rate for 3s.

upgrades.level2: Gains an additional 70% Dodge Rate.
upgrades.level3: Increases the Dodge Rate duration to 5s.
upgrades.level4: Gains an additional 100% Dodge Rate.

skills.name: Cloud-Piercer
skills.description: Artemis fires piercing arrows at the most vulnerable enemy, dealing DMG equal to 200% of ATK to each enemy hit.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG dealt to 220% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: Piercing arrows also deal bonus DMG equal to 15% of the target’s current HP.
upgrades.level4: Increases DMG dealt to 250% of ATK.

relic.name: Hail of Arrows
relic.description: Cloud-Piercer can be cast during Gale-Force Shot.

upgrades.level2: Reduces the cooldown of Cloud-Piercer by 50% during Gale-Force Shot.
upgrades.level3: Steadied Shot can be cast during Gale-Force Shot.
upgrades.level4: Reduces the cooldown of Steadied Shot by 50% during Gale-Force Shot.

coreMechanic.summary: As enemy instakills your team; as ally does nothing. No investment value.

athena.name: Athena
athena.description: Athena, goddess of wisdom and just war, embodies reason and strategy. She governs knowledge and handicraft, her power stretching from toolmaking to battlefield command.

skills.name: Aegis of Halo
skills.description: At combat start, Athena creates an aura near herself, reducing DMG taken by allies within by 10%. On the first cast, the aura grows to medium size, granting allies inside a shield equal to 200% of Athena's ATK while permanently enhancing the aura: she gains 5% DMG RED & ATK for each ally within the aura. On the second cast, all allies within the aura gain an additional 40% ATK SPD.

upgrades.level2: On the first cast, she gains 7.5% DMG RED & ATK for each ally within the aura.
upgrades.level3: Increases the shield strength to 240%.
upgrades.level4: On the second cast, all allies within the aura gain 60% ATK SPD.

skills.name: Divine Strike
skills.description: Swings the Aegis to deal DMG equal to 250% of ATK to the target and stun them for 1.5s.

upgrades.level2: She also gains a shield equal to 150% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: Increases DMG dealt to 270%.
upgrades.level4: Shield Strength increases to 200% ATK.

skills.name: Blessing of Halo
skills.description: Athena blesses the ally with the highest ATK, increasing their ATK SPD by 25%.

upgrades.level2: Increases ATK SPD to 35%.
upgrades.level3: Increases CRIT Rate by an additional 10%.
upgrades.level4: Increases ATK SPD to 45%. (Unlocks at Lv.261)

skills.name: Lay on Hands
skills.description: Showers the weakest ally and those nearby with sacred light, healing them for 200% ATK as HP and increasing their M-RES by 20% for 8s.

upgrades.level2: Restores HP equal to 220% ATK.
upgrades.level3: Increases the duration of M-RES boost by 12s.
upgrades.level4: Restores HP equal to 240% ATK. (Unlocks at Lv.281)

relic.name: Haloed Ablution
relic.description: Upon casting Aegis of Halo 3 times in a battle, deals 5% max HP (up to 200% ATK) as True DMG per sec to enemies within range for 8s.

upgrades.level2: For each surviving ally (excluding minions) within the aura, Athena gains 25% Armor, 25% M-RES, and 10% Energy Regen. (Unlock at Relic Lv.10)
upgrades.level3: Athena gains the enhanced first-cast effect of Aegis of Halo at combat start. (Unlock at Relic Lv.20)
upgrades.level4: Athena gains 50% DMG RED when there are at least 3 allies within her aura. (Unlock at Relic Lv.30)

coreMechanic.summary: High attack speed buff enabling Zeus judgment window. Hidden depth -- kit does many things but primary identity is Zeus enabler. Only invest to r20 with Divine Zeus.

synergyLinks.description: ATK speed buff directly amplifies Zeus Judgment window output.
ATK speed buff amplifies Hercules judgment window on same principle as Zeus.

values.label: Relic Lv.30: True DMG per second
Relic Lv.30: True DMG ATK cap

skills.name: Final Oathbinding
skills.description: Audhumla has a shorter ATK interval. Audhumla overloads her weapon, locking herself onto the nearest target. During this time, she gains 100% ATK SPD but cannot use Active Skills for 8s. If the target is outside her ATK range, she moves until she can attack the target. If the target becomes stealthed, untargetable, or falls, she switches targets.

upgrades.level2: Gains 30% DMG RED for the duration.
upgrades.level3: Gains 40% Lifesteal during the Ultimate.
upgrades.level4: Gains 30% Normal Attack and Basic Skill DMG.

skills.name: Primordial Repulsion
skills.description: When enemy units are nearby, deals DMG equal to 300% of ATK to the nearest target and knocks them back to the edge of the battlefield. When no enemy units are nearby, fires a laser at the farthest target, dealing DMG equal to 200% of ATK to units along the path.

upgrades.level2: Deals DMG equal to 500% of ATK to the nearest target and knocks them back to the edge of the battlefield.
upgrades.level3: The laser deals DMG equal to 300% of ATK to units along the path.
upgrades.level4: The laser deals DMG equal to 400% of ATK to units along the path.

skills.name: Triple-Fate Verdict
skills.description: Passive: Every third consecutive Normal Attack against the same enemy deals True DMG equal to 12% of the target's Max HP, up to 1200% of Audhumla's own ATK. Switching targets removes this effect.

upgrades.level2: Deals True DMG equal to 14% of the target's Max HP, up to 1400% of Audhumla's own ATK.
upgrades.level3: Deals True DMG equal to 16% of the target's Max HP, up to 1600% of Audhumla's own ATK.
upgrades.level4: Deals True DMG equal to 18% of the target's Max HP, up to 1800% of Audhumla's own ATK.

skills.name: Eternal Chainstrike
skills.description: Passive: When continuously attacking the same target, Audhumla heats up her weapon, gaining 30% ATK SPD with each attack, up to 300%. Switching targets resets the ATK SPD bonus.

upgrades.level2: Gains 40% ATK SPD with each attack.
upgrades.level3: Gains 50% ATK SPD with each attack.
upgrades.level4: Gains 60% ATK SPD with each attack.

relic.name: Endbringer
relic.description: Passive: When Audhumla is about to fall, she enters Overload state. While in Overload, she cannot fall for 10s and gains 100% ATK SPD for the duration. When the duration ends, she is guaranteed to fall. Guaranteed Fall cannot be prevented by any effect, but Audhumla can still be revived. While she cannot fall, she can still take DMG, be targeted, and be affected by Crowd Control.

upgrades.level2: While in Overload, gains the maximum ATK SPD of 300%.
upgrades.level3: While in Overload, gains Super Armor.
upgrades.level4: Triple-Fate Verdict is enhanced, dealing True DMG equal to 25% of the target's Max HP, up to 4000% of Audhumla's own ATK.

bastet.name: Bastet
bastet.description: Bastet, the black cat guardian of homes, embodies elegance and mystery.

skills.name: Nile Dance
skills.description: Bastet gracefully leaps toward the position of the enemy with the highest ATK, dealing DMG equal to 160% of ATK to enemies around her each time she lands.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG per hit to 180% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: Increases DMG per instance to 200% of ATK.
upgrades.level4: Removes the cooldown of Feline Agility during the skill.

skills.name: Bastet’s Spin
skills.description: Bastet spins her body and strikes nearby enemies 3 times, dealing DMG equal to 100% of ATK per strike and reducing their Hit Rate by 15% for 5s.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG per hit to 110% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: Reduces the Hit Rate of hit enemies by 20%.
upgrades.level4: Increases DMG per hit to 120% of ATK.

skills.name: Furball
skills.description: Creates orbs that orbit Bastet for 15s, dealing DMG equal to 42% of ATK per second to nearby enemies.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG dealt to 50% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: Duration extends to 30s.
upgrades.level4: Increases DMG dealt to 60% of ATK.

skills.name: Feline Agility
skills.description: When Bastet takes a single hit dealing DMG exceeding 10% of her max HP, she becomes immune to the DMG and gains 30% Dodge Rate for 6s. Can trigger once every 15s.

upgrades.level2: Dodge bonus lasts for 8s.
upgrades.level3: Gains a 50% Dodge Rate.
upgrades.level4: Dodge bonus lasts for 10s.

relic.name: Feline Celerity
relic.description: Gains 25% Dodge Rate when HP drops below 50%.

upgrades.level2: When dodging a hit, deals 100% ATK as DMG to the attacker.
upgrades.level3: Gains 35% Dodge Rate when HP drops below 50%.
upgrades.level4: When dodging a hit, deals 200% ATK as DMG to the attacker.

coreMechanic.summary: Frontline tank that solo-carries until the 5-team threshold. Requires dodge% on gear slots 2/3 to function. Transitions to dedicated frontline alongside Hercules at higher investment.

caishen.name: Caishen
caishen.description: Caishen, guardian of wealth, rules over the flow of riches, success, and opportunity. Able to grant fortune or strip possessions, Caishen rewards diligence and punishes greed.

skills.name: Golden Rejuvenation
skills.description: Deals DMG equal to 270% of ATK to a target and restores 200 Energy to himself.

upgrades.level2: Increases ATK bonus to 300%.
upgrades.level3: Restores 300 Energy to himself.
upgrades.level4: Increases ATK bonus to 330%. (Unlocks at Lv.281)

skills.name: Rollin' in Riches
skills.description: Caishen restores 100 Energy to allies in a large area around him and then restores 25 Energy per sec to them for the next 10s.

upgrades.level2: Increases Energy Regen to 30.
upgrades.level3: Also increases ATK of allies within range by 15% for 5s.
upgrades.level4: Increases Energy Regen to 35.

skills.name: Lucky Star Alight
skills.description: Before falling, becomes immune to the DMG and invincible for 2s. It can only trigger once.

upgrades.level2: Additionally restores HP equal to 200% ATK.
upgrades.level3: Additionally restores HP equal to 300% ATK.
upgrades.level4: The effect now trigger twice. (Unlocks at Lv.261)

skills.name: Endless Fortune
skills.description: Caishen is surrounded by 2 Golden Ingots upon entering battle. When a nearby ally's HP drops below 50%, an Ingot is consumed to restore 25% max HP to that ally. Using a Golden Ingot has an 8s CD for each Deity. Caishen can have a maximum of 3 Golden Ingots. Once all Golden Ingots are used, they are automatically replenished to full. This effect has a 20s CD.

upgrades.level2: Increases healing effect to 27%.
upgrades.level3: Golden Ingots +1 at combat start.
upgrades.level4: Increases healing effect to 30%.

relic.name: Fortune Leverage
relic.description: The first time an ally reaches 700 Energy, grants them 300 Energy.

upgrades.level2: The first time an ally reaches 650 Energy, grants them 350 Energy.
upgrades.level3: This effect can trigger repeatedly with a 15s CD. (Unlock at Relic Lv.20)
upgrades.level4: The first time an ally reaches 600 Energy, grants them 400 Energy. (Unlock at Relic Lv.30)

coreMechanic.summary: Best energy battery. Instant 100 energy to all nearby allies plus 25/s for 8s. CN calls him the eternal support regardless of meta shifts.

cancer.name: Cancer
cancer.description: Thethys, known as Cancer is the godess of familial warmth and protection, guardian of the oceans.

skills.name: Cancer's Dance
skills.description: Heals surrounding allies 3 times, each restoring HP equal to 100% of Cancer's ATK + 70 and removing 1 debuff.

upgrades.level2: The unit receiving the final heal gains 15% increased ATK for 5s.
upgrades.level3: Restores HP equal to 120% ATK per heal.
upgrades.level4: The ATK buff now lasts 10s.

skills.name: Nourish
skills.description: Restores HP equal to 250% ATK to the weakest ally.

upgrades.level2: Healing increases to 270%.
upgrades.level3: Now heals 2 allies.
upgrades.level4: Healing increases to 300%.

skills.name: Crab Shell
skills.description: When an ally drops below 30% HP, they gain Super Armor for 6s and a shield equal to 300% of ATK. It can trigger only once per battle.

upgrades.level2: Immediately restores 100 Energy when triggered.
upgrades.level3: Shield Strength increases to 400% ATK.
upgrades.level4: Immediately restores 200 Energy when triggered. (Unlocks at Lv.261)

skills.name: Shelter
skills.description: Increases DMG RED of the nearest frontline ally by 15% during battle.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG RED to 20%.
upgrades.level3: Increases that unit's M-RES by an additional 50%.
upgrades.level4: Gains 30% Effect RES. (Unlocks at Lv.281)

relic.name: Vanguard Crab
relic.description: Additionally grants the nearest frontline ally Crab Shell once at combat start.

upgrades.level2: Crab Shell increases the target's Armor and M-RES by 25%. (Unlock at Relic Lv.10)
upgrades.level3: Additionally grants all frontline allies Crab Shell once at combat start. (Unlock at Relic Lv.20)
upgrades.level4: Crab Shell increases the target's Armor and M-RES by 50%. (Unlock at Relic Lv.30)

coreMechanic.summary: Energy battery for frontline with super armor (CC immunity). Only useful Zodiac unit. PvP tier higher than PvE because super armor in 5v5 prevents CC-lock at initiation.

synergyLinks.description: Both provide energy and CC to frontline; together prevent complete CC-lock.
Super armor helps Meng Po frontline survive long enough for revive proc.

canopicjar.name: Canopic Jar
canopicjar.description: Momus is the god of mockery, sencure, sarcasm, and reproach, as well as the guardian of writers and poets. He delights in exposing the flaws of gods and mortals, reveling in just critique.

skills.name: Head to Head
skills.description: Leaps high and smashes into an enemy, dealing DMG equal to 400% of ATK and knocking them back.

capricorn.name: Capricorn
capricorn.description: Oannios, goddess of Capricorn, embodies the rebellion and free will of both mortals and gods.

skills.name: Swarpblaster
skills.description: Capricorn swaps positions with the symmetrically opposite enemy at combat start and drains 50% of their max HP, which is slowly restored over 5s.

upgrades.level2: The target takes 10% increased DMG during the effect.
upgrades.level3: The lost HP is slowly restored over 8s.
upgrades.level4: The target takes 20% increased DMG during the effect.

skills.name: Blade Dance
skills.description: Capricorn combines her blades and dances, dealing DMG equal to 100% of ATK 4 times to surrounding enemies. She restores HP equal to 20% of ATK for each enemy hit.

upgrades.level2: DMG dealt per hit increases to 115% ATK.
upgrades.level3: DMG dealt per hit increases to 130% ATK.

skills.name: Soulbind
skills.description: Capricorn stuns an enemy for 5s, dealing DMG equal to 50% of ATK to them per sec.

upgrades.level2: DMG dealt per sec increases to 60% ATK.
upgrades.level3: When cast, it increases her ATK SPD by 20% for the next 5s.

coreMechanic.summary: Pure positioning tech unit. Groups enemies into specific positions before AoE skills land. Requires advanced understanding of unit movement at fight start.

skills.name: Soul Ferry
skills.description: When entering battle, Charon deals damage based on a percentage of his ATK to the farthest unit and banishes the target to the Netherworld for a period of time. The banished target temporarily leaves the battlefield, cannot act, and cannot be selected by either side.

upgrades.level2: Increases the damage dealt to the target.
upgrades.level3: Extends the banish duration and additionally affects one more unit.
upgrades.level4: Further increases the damage dealt to the target.

skills.name: Lantern Scorching Current
skills.description: Charon channels continuously, directing a beam at the current target and dealing damage each second based on a percentage of his ATK. For every period of time the channel continues, this damage multiplier increases by a percentage, up to a cap. While channeling, Charon consumes Energy each second. If interrupted, he loses a portion of Energy.

upgrades.level2: Increases the damage dealt to the target each second.
upgrades.level3: Reduces the Energy consumed each second while channeling.
upgrades.level4: Further increases the damage dealt each second.

skills.name: Refuse Passage
skills.description: When any enemy unit approaches Charon, Charon banishes that unit for a period of time. After this effect triggers, it enters cooldown.

upgrades.level2: Extends the banish duration.
upgrades.level3: Reduces this skill's cooldown.
upgrades.level4: When triggered, Charon gains a Shield based on a percentage of his ATK.

skills.name: Nether River Descends
skills.description: Charon slowly summons the Nether River into the mortal world. If Charon does not move for a period of time, he gains the Nether River state. Once he moves, this state is removed. While in the Nether River state, Charon deals increased damage and gains increased Lifesteal.

upgrades.level2: While in the Nether River state, Charon's damage dealt is further increased.

cronus.name: Cronus
cronus.description: A Tempo/Cooldown/Control Support who manipulates fight tempo by debuffing enemy skill rotations, doubling allied active casts, saving near-death allies via time rewind, and projecting temporary copies of allied heroes into battle.

skills.name: Temporal Vortex

upgrades.level4: Stun duration is increased to 3s.

skills.name: Rewinding Remains
skills.description: When an allied unit is about to fall, Cronus rewinds that unit to its optimal state from the past 5 seconds. After the rewind, the target's ATK and ATK SPD are reduced by 90% for 2s. This skill has 18s CD.

upgrades.level2: Reduces the CD to 15s.
upgrades.level3: When Cronus is about to fall, this effect triggers once for free on himself.
upgrades.level4: Reduces the CD to 12s.

skills.name: Echo of Causality
skills.description: At the start of battle, mark the allied unit with the highest CD Reduction as [Time Traveler]. When the Time Traveler casts an Active Skill (excluding Ultimate and Entry Skill), that skill is cast again immediately. This effect has 20s CD.

upgrades.level2: Reduces the skill CD to 18s.
upgrades.level3: At the start of battle, reduce the initial CD of all allied units by 5s.
upgrades.level4: Reduces the skill CD to 15s.

relic.name: Doctrine of Time
relic.description: Every 15 seconds, Cronus cyclically projects a Translucent Echo of a teammate into the battle for 6 seconds. Projection priority: Time Traveler first, then allied units from highest to lowest ATK. The Projection inherits 50% of Cronus's ATK and Max HP, and all skills of the projected unit. The projected unit's character and skill levels scale with Cronus's level.

upgrades.level2: Upon entering the battlefield, the Translucent Echo refreshes all skill CDs. [Relic Lv.10]
upgrades.level3: Translucent Echo duration is increased to 10s. [Relic Lv.20]
upgrades.level4: Translucent Echo gains 1000 Energy upon entering battle.

coreMechanic.summary: Best support in game -- complete CC, complete support, full-map coverage. Full kit unlocked at base dupe. Delayed ultimate release requires precise timing control.

strengths: AoE anti-tempo Ultimate reduces enemy ATK Speed, delays active skills, and blocks Energy regeneration - three distinct debuff layers in one cast
Temporal Rift is Formation Break plus Double Stun - very effective against backline-dependent and positioning-reliant compositions
Rewinding Remains provides a save mechanic that restores an ally's full state, not just HP - Energy and buffs are preserved at the prior snapshot
Echo of Causality doubles one ally's active skill every rotation - a consistent, passive damage and utility multiplier that requires no execution overhead
Projection system creates a second temporary version of a key ally - at Relic Lv2 paired with a CD reset, this amounts to a second full team rotation
Temporal Rift Lv3 self-accelerates on cast frequency - the more your team plays actively, the faster formation disruption returns
Scales with team quality: the stronger the ally designated as Time Traveler or projected, the higher Cronus's multiplier output
weaknesses: Not a top pick for pure single-target boss DPS races where tempo manipulation and formation disruption are irrelevant
Value scales with ally quality - if the carry pool is weak, Cronus loses significant multiplier output
Relic-dependent: without Relic Lv2 the Projection system lacks its defining CD reset; without Lv4 the projection's impact is delayed
Against raw stat-check teams that simply overwhelm utility through damage output, Cronus's kit cannot compensate for large stat disparities alone
Rewinding Remains reduces the saved target's ATK and ATK Speed after triggering - the saved ally is temporarily weakened following the rescue window

As long as her companions stand, her Relic renders her untouchable. Stone of Three Fates shatters control effects and restores the afflicted, while Lycoris Bloom channels power to the ally closest to unleashing their Ultimate. With Mengpo present, the flow of battle bends around a single truth: for her allies, the end is never the end.

strengths: Full-HP revival creates a genuine second life for any fallen carry
Untargetability in early-fight phases protects the revival engine
Anti-CC cleanse fires passively at no cost — free value in any CC-heavy matchup
Lycoris Bloom rewards Energy-focused team construction with sustained ATK% and Energy regen
Relic energy feedback loop: ally deaths refuel Samsara stack generation
Backline peel from Waters of Oblivion repositions divers without consuming support actions
Enables aggressive playstyles and risk-heavy teams that would otherwise be unviable
weaknesses: Two or more heroes dying simultaneously exhausts both Samsara stacks at once
Untargetability has a hard headcount requirement — falls away as allies die
Stone of Three Fates has a cooldown; a second CC wave in the window receives no protection
Revival advantage negated by anti-revive mechanics on some boss encounters
Energy lock or silence stalls Samsara stack generation
Brings minimal direct damage — teams must field other dedicated damage sources

coreMechanic.summary: Off-tank sub-DPS with layered utility. Without dupe and relic investment she feeds enemy energy. Multiple non-obvious tricks in kit.

strengths: Applies Crimson Doom Mark at battle start passively — no ramp-up required for debuffing
Permanent ATK SPD reduction on marked enemies stacks up to 4× — grows more oppressive as the fight extends
Built-in self-revive through Drought Devil sources provides exceptional staying power
Energy drain/destruction on Ultimate can delay and disrupt enemy Ultimate rotations
Reliable Stun on Skill 1 against marked targets — near-100% CC uptime against tagged enemies
Passive lifesteal + overflow shield (Rite of Ashes) makes her self-sustaining once invested
Dual debuff coverage: DMG reduction + ATK SPD reduction simultaneously
weaknesses: At low dupe/relic investment, Doom Mark passive ticks can actually feed enemy Energy instead of draining it
Self-revive requires sources to exist — if marks expire before she dies, no revive token is available
Single-target focus on Ultimate active — mark re-application hits only the nearest enemy
No direct healing outside of the revive HP restore — vulnerable to sustained burst before marks expire
Utility-focused — needs supporting DPS; does not function as a standalone damage carry

coreMechanic.summary: Stance-dancing Physical carry. Her ultimate flips between a Black Stance (hits the default target, ramps +20% ATK per hit up to 3 stacks) and a White Stance (hits the weakest enemy, execute-flavored), and it picks the stance automatically from the ally-versus-enemy unit count. The Void Feint Relic is the real damage engine, adding per-hit %ATK + %target-HP riders that scale with the active stance. Step Into the Game converts incoming hits into a delayed Taiji reflect, while Clumsy Move Controls drains or refunds energy based on the energy gap.

strengths: Automatic stance switching adapts to the board on every ultimate - Black Stance ramps ATK for sustained single-target, White Stance pivots to the weakest enemy for cleanup
Void Feint Relic is the true damage engine: per-hit %ATK + %target-HP riders (up to 300% ATK + 10% max HP in Black, 400% ATK + 60% lost HP in White at Lv4) push her far above her base ATK
White Stance pairs %lost-HP damage with weakest-target selection, giving strong execute pressure to finish low units and bosses in their final phase
Step Into the Game turns incoming damage into a delayed Taiji reflect, rewarding her for being attacked and punishing multi-hit enemies
Clumsy Move Controls adds real energy disruption - draining up to 100 energy from higher-energy targets while refunding her own, delaying enemy ultimates
Switch & Strike buffs two designated allies (front White Stone, back Black Stone) with bonus damage / damage reduction plus a 500% ATK shield on conversion, so she supports while carrying
weaknesses: Stance is chosen by unit count, not player intent - in a losing fight with fewer allies she locks into White Stance even when the Black ramp would deal more
Black Stance ramp (max 3 stacks, +60% ATK) needs time on the same target; she is weak in the opening seconds before stacks and Relic riders build
Switch & Strike is heavily positioning-dependent - the front/back designations require intentional team construction and cannot be blind-slotted
Step Into the Game can be skipped by a single hard one-shot before the 3s Taiji Formation resolves
All damage is Physical, so enemy Armor and physical damage reduction hit her full kit; she has no magic or true component to bypass it
Energy drain and reflect value scale with fight length; in very short fights she underdelivers versus pure burst carries

upgrades.level3: Triggers Thundercrack upon reaching 8 stacks.
upgrades.level4: Increases DMG dealt by 50%.

relic.name: Divine Pulse
relic.description: When Zeus casts Almighty Thunderstrike, all Echoes on the field also cast it, dealing 70% of the original DMG.

upgrades.level2: After each Normal Attack, the next attack triggers Supreme Judgment. Increases Supreme Judgment DMG by 20%.
upgrades.level3: When Zeus casts Almighty Thunderstrike, all Echoes also cast it, dealing 100% of the original DMG.
upgrades.level4: Echoes can also trigger Divine Pulse and Supreme Judgment.

coreMechanic.summary: Most versatile unit -- functions in every mode, team, and progression stage. Judgment burst buffed by Athena ATK speed, Yuelao ATK buff, and Dionysus damage boost.

synergyLinks.description: ATK speed buff directly amplifies Judgment window output.
ATK buff and link chain -- Zeus hits harder and survives longer.
Maximum energy cycling for guaranteed Judgment uptime.
Damage-boost support completes the endgame meta support stack.
Diana armor debuff plus Zeus Judgment creates disproportionate burst.

notes: Global Judgment keeps the same ATK and current-HP percentages but uses much lower ATK caps for the current-HP damage portion. Global Zeus is undertuned vs the CN source here.
